# Verified on this machine, 2026-11-04.

# Every version below was installed into a clean venv on Python 3.14.7
# (CPython, MSC v.1944, 64-bit, Windows) and imported successfully. camb was
# additionally run, not merely imported, because importing a Fortran
# extension proves little:
#
#   camb.set_params(H0=67.5, ombh2=0.022, omch2=0.122, ns=0.965, As=2e-9)
#   -> rdrag = 146.989 Mpc, thetastar = 1.04465
#
# Reproduce with:
#   python -m venv .venv
#   .venv/Scripts/python -m pip install -r env/requirements.txt
#   .venv/Scripts/python verify/tracker_relations.py

# NOT AVAILABLE, and the plan does not depend on it:
#
# classy  - the CLASS Python wrapper. There is no wheel for ANY version on
#           this platform: pip reports "Could not find a version that
#           satisfies the requirement classy (from versions: none)". It is a
#           source distribution requiring a C toolchain and is known to be
#           difficult on Windows.
#
#           camb substitutes for every use this plan has: sound horizon,
#           theta_star, transfer functions and CMB spectra. Where a package
#           absolutely requires CLASS, the plan says so and that work does
#           not run on this machine.
#
#           Do not add classy to this file without first installing it
#           successfully and recording how.
